t: The Magnusson Grip 330 LED pen torch delivers powerful inspection lighting in a compact hand-held design. This durable aluminium pocket torch is ideal for electricians, plumbers and automotive technicians working in tight spaces. With high and low light modes, the device projects a bright beam up to 230m to illuminate dark work areas. Powered by 3 x AAA batteries, it offers a reliable runtime of up to 9 hours without the need for recharging. An IP44 rating ensures splash protection, making this robust tool suitable for everyday trade use in demanding environments.
